invariants.rationale: The method immediately dereferences tmjFile in json.parse(tmjFile), so it cannot be null.
The method always returns the result of getDependencyAssetDescriptors, which should not return null.

invariants.expression: result == getDependencyAssetDescriptors(tmjFile, parameter != null ? new TextureLoader.TextureParameter() {{ genMipMaps = parameter.generateMipMaps; minFilter = parameter.textureMinFilter; magFilter = parameter.textureMagFilter; }} : new TextureLoader.TextureParameter())
invariants.rationale: The result is always created by getDependencyAssetDescriptors with tmjFile and a TextureLoader.TextureParameter based on parameter.
fileName is not dereferenced here, but it is unusual for input filenames to be null in resource loader contexts.
If parameter is not null, textureParameter fields are set based on parameter and passed to getDependencyAssetDescriptors.
